reuse.why: Threads holidays through the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend that all moving call sites already use, but the daily-skip paths test holidays inline instead of through a shared predicate.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' test is written three times: inside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, in getNextDate's daily loop and in getDatesInRange's daily check.

placement.why: The moving rule stays in shared/schedules.ts and the type in models/schedule.ts; the daily-skip duplication in server/schedules/app.ts is pre-existing layering, extended rather than fixed.

scope.why: Only the weekend-handling call sites, the recurrence data, the type and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Correctly covers every path, but a future change to what counts as a non-business day must be made in three inline expressions; the loop bound 7 + holidays.length is an ad-hoc heuristic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: all date-moving call sites go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the daily-skip checks had no shared predicate to use

disguised_duplication.where: the inline weekend-or-holiday checks in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange are open repetitions, not disguised

one_place.where: The holiday-as-weekend rule is decided in getDateWithSkippedWeekend (shared/schedules.ts) and again inline in getNextDate's daily loop and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts)
